name: cruise-deck
description: Cruise Deck full-stack React app with login and authentication

scripts.synth: pnpm --filter infra exec cdk synth --profile DRoemhildt19
scripts.diff: pnpm --filter infra exec cdk diff cruise-deck-api cruise-deck-ui --profile DRoemhildt19
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter infra exec cdk deploy cruise-deck-api cruise-deck-ui --profile DRoemhildt19 --require-approval never
scripts.github-action-deploy: biome check . && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter infra exec cdk deploy cruise-deck-api cruise-deck-ui --require-approval never
